description: TI DAC43204 8-bit quad voltage/current-output smart DAC, I2C/PMBus/SPI, 1.7-5.5 V, WQFN-16 RTE

pinout.name: GPIO/SDO
pinout.notes: GPIO (LDAC, PD, PROTECT, RESET, SDO, STATUS); may be pulled high before VDD

pinout.name: SCL/SYNC
pinout.notes: I2C clock or SPI chip select

pinout.name: A0/SDI
pinout.notes: I2C address pin or SPI data in

pinout.name: CAP
pinout.notes: internal LDO bypass capacitor (about 1.5 uF to AGND)

pinout.name: VREF
pinout.notes: external reference input; pull up to VDD when unused; must not ramp before VDD

abs_max.param: Current into any pin except OUTx

pin_ratings.source: TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, VDD supply to AGND: 'VDD 电源电压，VDD（至 AGND） –0.3 6 V'
TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, digital inputs to AGND: 'AGND 的数字输入 -0.3 VDD + 0.3 V'
TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, CAP to AGND: 'CAP（至 AGND） -0.3 1.65 V'
TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, VFBX to AGND: 'VFBX（至 AGND） -0.3 VDD + 0.3 V'
TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, VOUTX to AGND: 'VOUTX（至 AGND） -0.3 VDD + 0.3 V'
TI DACx3204 datasheet ZHCSNQ3A (Chinese, Mar 2021 rev. Dec 2021) p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, VREF to AGND: 'VREF 外部基准电压，VREF（至 AGND） -0.3 VDD + 0.3 V'
